reviewer.role: Evidence-based security, privacy, sovereignty and compliance architecture assurance

scopeChecks.securityArchitecture: The presentation accurately labels the private Citadel/landing-zone, least-privilege identity, private-network, policy, telemetry and recovery material as approved design intent or planned controls. It does not represent those controls as deployed or operating effectively.
scopeChecks.identityRbacPimAndKeyManagement: The presentation aligns with Entra-only human access, PIM, per-component managed identities, no standing Owner, no shared credentials or GitHub OIDC, private RBAC Key Vault and platform-managed encryption as a baseline. Tenant identities, key-custody decisions and operating evidence remain owner-dependent gates.
scopeChecks.networkMonitoringContinuity: Private ingress, APIM lockdown sequencing, private endpoints, DNS, egress allow-lists, alerts, runbooks, rollback posture and recovery targets are presented as design or planned acceptance evidence. No runtime availability, RTO, RPO, failover or incident-response result is claimed.
scopeChecks.supplyChainAndProvenance: The r11 deck lockfile, static bundle, local browser evidence, PDF evidence and Phase 5 digests/SBOMs are hash-bound. Zero external browser requests, no active external SVG constructs, zero disclosed credential/private-key scan findings and deterministic artefact evidence support the presentation boundary. Phase 5 licence review, approved release identity and transparency-log publication remain unresolved and are not represented as passed.
scopeChecks.dataPrivacySovereigntyAndCompliance: Claims retain the EU Data Zone and private-data design boundary while keeping exact regions, provider terms, data classification, retention, legal hold, deletion, GDPR detail, EU AI Act role/use-case classification and DORA applicability as fail-closed owner work. No legal conclusion, certification or formal compliance attestation is made.
scopeChecks.claimReferenceTraceability: All 38 material claims and all 69 declared source references were checked for present source paths. Claim classifications distinguish source facts, approved design intent, local static validation, hypotheses and untested runtime behaviour; the USD 200000 comparator remains a HUMAN_OWNED_HYPOTHESIS.
scopeChecks.phaseAndExecutionBoundary: Phase 6 remains an unapproved presentation candidate. The review performed no Azure sign-in, query, what-if, deployment, runtime inference or runtime testing. Phase 7 and Phase 8 remain human-only, separately authorised and NOT_INVOKED.
scopeChecks.reproducibility: The 173-artifact manifest, exact 175-file tree, r10 source/PDF/screenshot parity and byte-identical reviewed-subject snapshot matched before and after the read-only review.

residualOwnerGates.statement: External distribution remains blocked pending accountable owner rights confirmation or asset replacement. This review makes no source, asset, copyright, trademark, licence or redistribution conclusion.

residualOwnerGates.owner: Accountable platform, privacy, records, legal, compliance and commercial owners
residualOwnerGates.statement: Regions and identifiers, capacity, embeddings and benchmarks, recovery/failover, provider terms, source permissions, licence compatibility, privacy lifecycle, retention/legal hold, classification, release identity and future Azure/runtime evidence remain unresolved and fail closed.

No Azure sign-in, target validation, what-if, deployment, inference, promotion, realised benefit, operating effectiveness, certification, legal conclusion, production-readiness evidence or optional-phase execution exists. A human Phase 6 r11 decision remains pending.

rationale: The independently verified frozen r11 subject supports its security, privacy, sovereignty, supply-chain, deployment-boundary and compliance-representation claims without asserting owner-dependent controls as achieved. No demonstrable BLOCKER, MAJOR or MINOR defect was found. The unwaived asset-rights, owner-evidence and human-decision gates remain explicit, fail closed and prevent a CONFORMS verdict.
nonApprovalStatement: AFF-B provides architecture assurance only. This record approves nothing, waives nothing, provides no legal advice, legal or regulatory certification, formal attestation or owner-gate resolution, authorises no external distribution or Azure activity, and does not invoke Phase 7 or Phase 8.
nextAction: Keep r11 unchanged and unapproved. Do not resolve or waive the residual owner gates, authorise external distribution, update lifecycle surfaces through this review, perform Azure activity, or invoke optional phases. The authorised coordinator process must separately handle coverage, lifecycle/preview evidence and the later explicit human decision.
